anaemia.definition:
n a lack of vitality
n a deficiency of red blood cells
anaemia.translation:
n. 贫血, 贫血症, 无活力
[医] 贫血

anaemias.definition:
plural of anaemia
n a lack of vitality
n a deficiency of red blood cells

(anaemia 的复数) n. 贫血, 贫血症, 无活力
[医] 贫血

anaemic.definition:
a relating to anemia or suffering from anemia
s lacking vigor or energy
anaemic.translation: a. 贫血的, 患贫血症的, 无活力的

anaemics.definition:
plural of anaemic
a relating to anemia or suffering from anemia

anaerobe.definition: n. an organism (especially a bacterium) that does not require air or free oxygen to live
anaerobe.translation:
n. 厌氧菌
[医] 厌氧菌

anaerobes.definition:
plural of anaerobe
n. an organism (especially a bacterium) that does not require air or free oxygen to live
anaerobes.translation:
(anaerobe 的复数) n. 厌氧菌
[医] 厌氧菌

anaerobic.definition:
a. living or active in the absence of free oxygen
a. not aerobic
anaerobic.translation:
a. 厌氧的, 在缺氧情况下生活的
[化] 厌氧的

anaerobic bacteria.translation: [化] 厌氧细菌; 厌气细菌

anaerobic culture.translation:

[医] 乏氧呼吸

anaerobic tank.translation: [医] 化粪池, 加水分解池

anaerobion.translation: 嫌气的, 厌气生物, 厌氧菌

anaerobiosis.translation: n. [生]乏氧生活, 厌气生活

anaerobiotic.definition: a living or active in the absence of free oxygen

anaerobism.translation: [医] 厌氧生活力, 乏氧生活力

anaesthecinesis.translation: [医] 感觉与运动能力缺失

anaesthesia.definition: n loss of bodily sensation with or without loss of consciousness
anaesthesia.translation:
n. 麻木, 麻醉

anaesthesin.translation:
[化] 苯佐卡因; 阿奈西辛
[医] 阿奈西辛, 对氨基苯甲酸乙酯, 苯佐卡因

anaesthesine.translation: [化] 苯佐卡因; 阿奈西辛
